claims.claim_text: D-Wave completed the acquisition of Quantum Circuits, Inc. on January 20, 2026 for 10,430,444 Common Shares plus $250.0 million in cash, positioning D-Wave as a dual-platform (annealing + gate-model) quantum computing company.

params.parent_thesis: Annealing quantum computing leader pivoting to dual-platform by adding gate-model error-correction technology

acquisitions.tech: dual-rail superconducting gate-model qubits with error detection

claims.claim_text: During 2025 D-Wave executed massive ATM equity issuance: $146.1M ($150M ATM, Q1 2025), $390.6M ($400M ATM, Q2 2025), $37.8M (Lincoln Park), plus $202.9M from warrant exercises -- gross 2025 financing inflows ~$779M. This is heavy dilution timed around favorable share-price periods.

claims.claim_text: D-Wave claims more than 25 years of pioneering quantum-annealing innovation and a defensible IP/patent foundation in superconducting flux qubits, hybrid solvers, and now (via Quantum Circuits acquisition) dual-rail error-corrected qubits.

claims.source_quote: As a pioneer in the quantum industry for more than 25 years, D-Wave is the world s first company to deliver commercial-grade annealing quantum computing systems

claims.claim_text: D-Wave operates four leased facilities: Burnaby BC (42,000 sqft R&D + manufacturing), Richmond BC (7,000 sqft superconducting circuit board fab), Palo Alto CA (6,000 sqft in-house fabrication), and New Haven CT (18,000 sqft gate-model R&D, added Feb 2026). Planning new Boca Raton FL HQ + R&D facility.

claims.source_quote: We operate four facilities in North America... Burnaby, British Columbia ... Richmond, British Columbia ... New Haven, Connecticut ... claims.claim_text: Launched sixth-generation Advantage2 annealing quantum computer (May 2025) with >4,400 qubits, 1,200-qubit prototype delivered 'quantum supremacy' result in March 2025 (published in Science). Customers can buy on-premises systems or access via Leap cloud.

claims.source_quote: In May 2025, we launched our sixth-generation annealing quantum computing system, Advantage2 ... access to our annealing quantum computers that have more than 4,400 qubits

claims.claim_text: FY2025 revenue of $24.6M, up from $8.8M in FY2024 (~180% growth). FY2025 operating loss $100.4M, net loss $355.1M (driven by $270.5M warrant mark-to-market), accumulated deficit $982.0M. Going-concern adjacent profile despite $457M cash build.
